title: A New Approach to Black Hole Thermodynamics in General EMD-like Theories
summary: We consider general EMD-like theories involving arbitrary numbers of both Maxwell fields and dilatonic scalars. We study charged black holes and derive several algebraic and differential relations among the thermodynamic quantities, scalar charges and the non-extremal parameter. These allow us to obtain two sets of master equations of thermodynamic quantities, depending on the choice of basic variables parameterizing the system.
